basis: US national-average installed unit costs (material + labor + equipment incl. the installing subcontractor's O&P, like RSMeans 'Total incl. O&P'), Q4 2025 dollars, location index 1.00, then moved to Hattiesburg, MS with the location factor below. Shared items use the same basis as the parent demo's data/unit_costs.json (Linbeck Q3 2025 forecast, RSMeans-typical magnitudes, 2025 steel/aluminum tariffs). Items marked 'Estimated' are budget figures from comparable RSMeans line items or vendor ranges, not quotes. Excludes GC general conditions, fee, contingency and escalation (added as markups).

location_factor.note: Typical RSMeans city cost index for zip prefix 394 (labor-driven), as in the parent demo; confirm against the current annual CCI table.

benchmark.label: RSMeans 3-storey hospital, US national average 2025
benchmark.note: Gordian/RSMeans square-foot model, 2025; up 1.3% on 2024 and 21.4% over five years. A 7-storey acute-care building with a central plant and helipad sits above a 3-storey model.

piles.note: Estimated: 18" auger-cast pile, 60 ft assumed (piles are not modeled; count from the 6- and 9-pile caps), ~$70-90/LF incl. rebar cage and grout, plus mobilization share. Depth needs a geotechnical report.

pile_caps.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 03 30 53.40 pile caps: concrete $146-170/CY (Linbeck Q3 2025) + forms, heavy rebar (~150 lb/CY), placing and excavation.

footings.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 03 30 53.40 spread and strip footings incl. forms, rebar and placing; also used for the 12" foundation slab.

found_walls.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 03 30 53.40 foundation walls (two-side forming, rebar, placing, damp-proofing).

sog.note: Parent demo's 6" SOG ($9.75/SF) plus the modeled 12" granular base and vapor barrier.

slab_on_deck.note: 6" normal-weight concrete on 3" deck (~0.019 CY/SF): concrete, pump, WWF/rebar, finish and pour stops; parent demo's LW fill scaled for the thicker NW slab.

conc_columns.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 03 30 53.40 columns, 4' square class, incl. forms, rebar and placing.

brick_wall.note: Brick veneer on 6" metal studs incl. sheathing, insulation, air/water barrier, ties and flashing (RSMeans/BIA installed wall-system study, escalated).

cmu_ext.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 04 22 10.14 8" CMU, reinforced and grouted, plus water repellent.

cmu_int.note: Same as the parent demo's CMU core wall: 8" CMU + vertical reinforcing and grouted cells.

masonry_cols.note: Estimated: brick and cut-limestone column cladding on backup, priced per SF of enclosure face (from the model geometry).

steel_framing.note: Parent demo basis: Linbeck Q3 2025 fabricated steel $4,028-4,350/ton + erection $1,728-2,100/ton. Tonnage = Revit volume x 490 lb/ft3. Excludes fireproofing.

steel_columns.note: Parent demo basis; heavy W14 columns carry fewer connection hours per ton. Includes base plates and splices.

floor_deck.note: 3" 20 ga composite deck with shear studs; parent demo's 2" deck ($5.00) plus ~15% for the deeper profile and studs.

stair.note: Parent demo basis: steel pan stair with concrete-filled treads incl. stringers and landings. Risers from the modeled stair height at 7" max riser.

cable_rail.note: Estimated: 42" stainless cable guardrail with 1-1/2" top rail, fascia- or stringer-mounted.

pipe_rail.note: Parent demo basis: RSMeans 05 52 13.50 steel pipe railings, blended.

metal_panel.note: Estimated: insulated metal panel or composite panel rainscreen on 6" studs with sheathing, insulation and air/water barrier.

roofing.note: Parent demo basis: fully adhered membrane + 4" tapered polyiso + cover board + flashings. Also prices the membrane added on every open structural slab (area from geometry).

ballast_roof.note: Estimated: loose-laid membrane with insulation and stone ballast.

green_roof.note: Estimated: extensive green roof (growing medium, drainage mat, plants, root barrier) over the roofing membrane.

paver_roof.note: Estimated: concrete pavers on adjustable pedestals over membrane and insulation.

soffit.note: Estimated: 2" aluminum composite metal panel soffit on framing.

curtain_wall.note: Parent demo basis: Linbeck Q3 2025 curtain wall $99-103/SF; +23% aluminum PPI. Mullions are in the SF rate.

spandrel.note: Estimated: insulated spandrel glass in the curtain-wall frame, ~10% under vision glass.

channel_glass.note: Estimated: U-channel glass (Profilit-type) wall system, insulated, budget figure; proprietary - get a quote.

storefront.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 08 43 13 aluminum storefront with IGU; fixed windows at the same rate.

louver.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 08 91 19 extruded aluminum drainable louvres; area is one face.

door_single.note: Parent demo's interior door ($2,100) plus healthcare hardware (lever sets, kick plates, closers).

door_double.note: Estimated: pair of solid-core doors in HM frame with healthcare hardware; double-acting pairs at the same rate.

door_auto.note: Estimated: automatic bi-parting sliding entrance, aluminum storefront, operator, sensors and breakout panels.

door_ext_pair.note: Parent demo's aluminum entrance leaf ($4,500) x 2, framing carried in the curtain wall.

door_overhead.note: Estimated: 8' x 10' insulated sectional dock door with operator.

part_1hr.note: Parent demo basis: 1-hr stud partition, 5/8" Type X each side, primer + 2 coats paint both sides.

part_2hr.note: Estimated: 2-hr partition (two layers Type X each side) incl. paint, ~25% over 1-hr.

feature_wall.note: Estimated allowance for the donor wall and the lobby water wall (finish, glass, water feature equipment).

act_ceiling.note: Parent demo's 2x2 ACT ($6.00) + healthcare-grade washable tile.

gyp_ceiling.note: Estimated: suspended gypsum board ceiling and soffits, taped and painted.

column_cover.note: Estimated: gypsum or metal column enclosures, per SF of enclosure face (geometry).

toilet_part.note: Parent demo basis: toilet compartment with door, panels and pilaster, installed.

grab_bar.note: Estimated: stainless grab bar set, installed with blocking.

helipad.note: Estimated: elevated rooftop helipad (deck, perimeter safety net, lighting, wind cone, foam fire protection). Wide range; depends on FAA design and structure.

casework.note: Estimated: nurse station casework with solid-surface tops (per station); counters at ~12 LF per station.

elevator.note: Estimated: 4,500 lb hospital stretcher traction elevator, 7-8 stops, incl. cab and state inspection; count = modeled cabins.

water_closet.note: Parent demo's flush-valve water closet ($1,350) wall-hung with carrier.

lavatory.note: Parent demo's lavatory ($1,050) with sensor faucet for healthcare.

shower.note: Estimated: thermostatic shower valve, hand shower with slide bar, drain; enclosure and finishes excluded.

urinal.note: Parent demo basis: wall-hung urinal with flush valve.

piping_hydronic.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 23 21 13 Schedule 40 steel, 4-8", welded, with hangers, fittings and insulation. Length estimated from the modeled pipe surface area at the system's typical diameter.

piping_plumbing.note: Estimated: copper domestic hot water and cast-iron sanitary mains incl. fittings and hangers. Length from modeled surface area.

piping_medgas.note: Estimated: type K/L medical-gas copper, brazed with nitrogen purge, certified. Length from modeled surface area.

medgas_outlet.note: Estimated: medical gas outlet (O2 / vacuum / air), rough-in and finish; triple panels count per outlet element.

ahu.note: Estimated: custom hospital AHU (~50,000 CFM, HEPA final filters, redundant fan array, humidifier) at ~$6.50/CFM installed incl. rigging; vendor figures put a 30,000 CFM HEPA unit at ~$3.70/CFM for the unit and install alone.

chiller.note: Estimated: ~500-ton water-cooled screw chiller, set, piped and started (~$900/ton).

boiler.note: Estimated: 16,750 MBH water-tube boiler with burner, controls, breeching and startup.

cooling_tower.note: Estimated: closed-circuit counterflow cooling tower (605 MBH), set and piped.

fan.note: Estimated: inline tubular centrifugal fan 1,000-5,600 CFM with controls.

vav.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 23 36 16 VAV terminal units with DDC controls.

coil.note: Estimated: duct-mounted hot-water reheat coil with valve and piping connection.

diffuser.note: Estimated: 24x24 lay-in supply diffuser or return grille with flex connection.

ductwork.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 23 31 13.13 galvanized rectangular ductwork incl. fittings, hangers and wrap insulation (commercial, well above residential per-lb rates online). Weight = modeled duct surface x 1.15 lb/SF.

pv.note: Commercial rooftop PV $1.60-2.80/W installed before incentives (2025 vendor guides; SEIA/WoodMac ~$1.77/W); 0.4 kW per modeled panel.

al_elec.note: Allowance: hospital electrical (normal/emergency power, generators, lighting, nurse call, IT/low voltage) typically ~18-22% of building cost.

al_fp.note: Allowance: wet-pipe sprinklers, standpipes and fire pump.

al_plumb.note: Allowance: domestic water, sanitary/vent and storm distribution and med-gas zone valves/alarms beyond the modeled mains and fixtures.

al_hvac.note: Allowance: branch ductwork, exhaust systems, terminal piping, building automation and TAB beyond the modeled systems.

al_fin.note: Allowance: resilient/sheet flooring and tile, corner guards and wall protection, paint not in partitions, signage.

al_site.note: Allowance: sitework, paving and parking, site utilities, stormwater and landscaping (the site model was left out of this demo).

roof_drain.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 22 14 26.13 cast-iron roof drain with overflow, connected to the leader.

markups.note: General conditions 8-10% for a ~2.5-year hospital job; bonds & builder's risk 1.5-2.5%; GC fee 4-6%; 10% design contingency at schematic level (AACE / ASTM E2516 practice); escalation 4%/yr from Q4 2025 prices to the construction midpoint.

exclusions: Medical and owner equipment, FF&E, IT hardware
Design and consultant fees, permits, impact fees, land and financing
Hazardous material abatement, unforeseen rock or soil conditions
